summary: Harden CI and architecture boundaries without constraining intentional UI/UX redesign, and isolate reusable FX composition from its HTTP adapter.
protectedReason: The change intentionally strengthens CI and architecture enforcement while explicitly keeping presentation structure and UI/UX redesign outside the protected invariants. Currency FX HTTP composition is separated from the reusable provider/application module so downstream financial modules do not inherit transport-layer decorators.
